title: Charlemont Square, Charlemont Street, Dublin 2

prs.location:
The Locks is a premium residential development ideally located just moments from Dublin’s premier retail district, renowned dining destinations, St. Stephen’s Green, and Harcourt Street. The sought-after neighbourhoods of Ranelagh and Rathmines are also within easy reach—just a six-minute walk away.

Charlemont is exceptionally well-connected, with the Luas Green Line only a three-minute stroll from your doorstep, along with numerous Dublin Bus routes serving the area. For added convenience, GoCar and Dublin City Bikes are located adjacent to the development.

Residents can enjoy a wealth of nearby green spaces and scenic walking routes, including St. Stephen’s Green, Iveagh Gardens, and the picturesque Grand Canal Walk, just one minute away. The thoughtfully designed central plaza at Charlemont Square features landscaped gardens, outdoor fitness equipment, a children’s playground, and ample bike storage—offering a perfect blend of city living and tranquil retreat.

description:
Elegant 1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Apartments and Penthouses To Let

Charlemont Square is a landmark new development offering luxurious apartments and penthouses in a prime Dublin 2 location—just a short walk from Ranelagh, Portobello, and St. Stephen's Green.

Developed by the acclaimed McGarrell Reilly Group, this vibrant city-centre scheme blends high-end living with urban convenience. At the heart of the development is a beautifully landscaped public plaza, home to cafés, restaurants, retail units, and a Tesco supermarket, placing every essential amenity at residents' fingertips.

Each apartment is meticulously designed with a focus on light, space, and contemporary comfort. A2-rated for energy efficiency, homes feature floor-to-ceiling windows, bespoke kitchens with quartz countertops and integrated Siemens appliances, and spacious utility rooms with built-in shelving, washing machine, and dryer.

Apartments also benefit from high ceilings, light grey wood flooring, and excellent built-in wardrobe storage throughout. Many units include a Winter Garden—an enclosed balcony space ideal for relaxation or enjoying the outdoors all year round. Bathrooms and ensuites are finished with premium Villeroy & Boch sanitary ware, rain showers, and heated towel rails.

Residents enjoy exceptional views of the city, mountains, and canal, all within a secure, beautifully crafted urban setting.

Location: The Locks is a luxurious development just a stone's throw from Dublin's premier retail district, fine dining options, St. Stephen's Green, and Harcourt Street. Nearby neighbourhoods, such as Ranelagh and Rathmines, are only a six-minute walk away. The Charlemont area is well-served by public transport, including the Luas, which is just a three-minute walk away, along with several bus routes at your doorstep. Additionally, car rental services like GoCar and City Bikes are conveniently located adjacent to Charlemont Square. Charlemont Square features several picturesque walking routes through some of South Dublin's most beloved parks, including St. Stephen's Green and Iveagh Gardens, as well as the nearby Canal Walk, just a minute away. The plaza at Charlemont Square has been thoughtfully designed with an outdoor playground, exercise equipment, bike racks, and beautiful landscaping. 

The Finer Details: 
- All apartments are fitted with the highest standard of furnishings and finishes, showcasing impeccable design and attention to detail. 
- Bespoke floor-to-ceiling kitchens feature quartz countertops and integrated Siemens appliances.
- Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows maximize natural light. 
- Spacious utility rooms include a washing machine and dryer, with built-in shelving.
 - Luxurious bathrooms and ensuites are equipped with Villeroy & Boch sanitary ware, heated towel rails, and high-quality quartz countertops.
